hooks.command: node scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs SessionStart 2>/dev/null || node ~/.claude/skills/forge/scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs SessionStart 2>/dev/null || true
node scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs UserPromptSubmit 2>/dev/null || node ~/.claude/skills/forge/scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs UserPromptSubmit 2>/dev/null || true

node dist/src/check-frozen.js "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || node forge/dist/src/check-frozen.js "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || node ~/.claude/skills/forge/dist/src/check-frozen.js "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '\.forge/(specs|plans)/[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+|\.forge/config\.md' | sort -u | while read -r f; do node dist/src/check-frozen.js "$f" 2>/dev/null || node forge/dist/src/check-frozen.js "$f" 2>/dev/null || node ~/.claude/skills/forge/dist/src/check-frozen.js "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; done
if [ -f .forge/status.md ]; then echo '📝 代码已修改。请记得更新 .forge/progress/ 中的任务状态。'; fi
node scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs Stop 2>/dev/null || node ~/.claude/skills/forge/scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs Stop 2>/dev/null || true

phase=$(grep '^phase:' .forge/status.md 2>/dev/null | sed 's/phase: *"\{0,1\}//;s/"\{0,1\} *$//'); if [ "$phase" = 'review' ] || [ "$phase" = 'decide' ]; then echo '队友空闲。请检查是否所有评审/决策维度都已完成输出，未完成的队友应继续工作。'; fi
echo '✅ 团队任务已完成。负责人请汇总队友输出并检查是否需要合并发现。'
node scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs PreCompact 2>/dev/null || node ~/.claude/skills/forge/scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs PreCompact 2>/dev/null || true
node scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs PostCompact 2>/dev/null || node ~/.claude/skills/forge/scripts/forge-hook-dispatch.mjs PostCompact 2>/dev/null || true
